test_name: Camera toolbox stays open across sandbox exit - 3e73f715-6626-4558-ab35-69b23345a93a
summary: Passed because in the editor the camera toolbox now closes itself when you press Edit in sandbox and when you leave the scene, and its pause no longer comes back when you return to play. The toolbox was never told to close on a scene change or on the switch to edit mode, so it stayed open into the main menu, and on returning to play it restored its saved 'paused' state, freezing the game and hiding the open button. It now closes the normal way in both cases, in single player only. In the test the button to open it showed again after returning to play.
instructions:
TASK: camera toolbox breaks sandbox

DESCRIPTION:
2 major issues:

1. when entering sandbox and opening the camera toolbox inside, then when you exit to main menu you still have the camera toolbox there, and it lets you capture the main menu which is bad.
2. when entering sandbox and opening the camera toolbox inside, then when you press the edit button you exit the sandbox and i can see the camera toolbox panel still open for a second then it disappears, then after you enter the sandbox again the game is frozen, you can't open the camera toolbox, and only when i open the menu again everything becomes unpaused for a moment and then paused again.

 

I believe the issue is that when switching scenes(maybe only in sandbox and maybe in every SP mode) when the camera toolbox is open, it doesn't close it correctly before switching scenes which causes it to either stay or bug the game out.

REQUEST (from Amit):
@Big Sys investigate and fix again, i added more context

EXTRA (from the card):
Thread shows this is a repeat request: Amit previously asked to "investigate and fix" and is now asking again after adding more context (the description's two issues).

JOB TYPE:
BUG FIX - card has the `Bug` label and describes two issues where existing behaviour breaks (toolbox persists into main menu, game freezes after exiting sandbox)

GAME MODE:
SINGLEPLAYER - card has the `SinglePlayer` label
verified: Toolbox opened in sandbox play pauses the game (timeScale 0, IsOpen true)
Switching sandbox to Edit (TryLoadAsync Edit, as the Edit button does) closes the toolbox: IsOpen false, setting false, no TimeScale key held by the viewer
Returning to Play: toolbox stays closed, viewer holds no pause, CanOpenHere true and CameraToolboxPauseMenu.ShowButton true
Reopened toolbox then PauseMenuManager.OnExitToMainMenu: the primary scene transition closes the toolbox (IsOpen false, setting false)
not_done: The real main menu scene was not loaded - with the Sandbox (Play) debug config, exit reloads the sandbox; the same primary-transition close path ran
Regression (toolbox stays open in sandbox play with no transition, and across a respawn) was not exercised - respawn is not a scene transition, so the close path does not run there
Multiplayer not tested; the scene-transition close is skipped in multiplayer by design
